verses.t: I was small among my brothers, and the youngest of the sons of my father; He has placed me as shepherd of his flock, and ruler of his kids.
My hand has made a pipe, and my fingers a lyre; And I will ascribe esteem to Yahuah, I have said so in my nephesh.
The mountains will not testify of him, and the hills will not tell; The trees exult my words, and the flocks my works.
For who will tell, and who will speak, and who will recount the works of the Master? Aluahim has seen everything, he has heard everything and he has given ear.
He sent his naḇi to anoint me, Shamu'Al to magnify me; My brothers went out to meet him, beautiful in form and beautiful in sight.
The heights of their stature, the beauty of their hair, yet Yahuah Aluahim did not choose them.
He sent and took me from behind the flock, and anointed me with qadash (Set Apart) oil; He appointed me leader of his people, and ruler of the sons of his berith.

151.intro: A HalleluYah of Dawiḏ son of Yahshai.

verses.t: O Aluahim, O Aluahim, come to my aid; Help me and save me, deliver my nephesh from the slayer.
Shall I go down to Sheol by the mouth of the lion, or shall the wolf confound me?
Was it not enough for them that they lay in wait for my father's flock, and rent in pieces a sheep of my father's drove, but they were wishing also to destroy my nephesh?
Have pity, O Yahuah, and save your qadash (Set Apart One) from destruction, that he may rehearse your splendours in all his times, and may praise your great name.
When you have delivered him from the hands of the destroying lion and of the ravening wolf, and when you have rescued my captivity from the hands of the wild beasts.
Quickly, O my Master, send from before you a deliverer, and draw me out of the gaping pit, which imprisons me in its depths.

152.intro: Spoken by Dawiḏ when he was contending with the lion and the wolf which took a sheep from his flock.

verses.t: Praise Yahuah, all you nations, esteem him, and bless his name;
Who rescued the nephesh of his elect from the hands of death, and delivered his qadash (Set Apart One) from destruction;
And saved me from the nets of Sheol, and my nephesh from the pit that cannot be fathomed.
Because, before my deliverance could go forth from before him, I was nearly rent in two pieces by two wild beasts.
But he sent his mal'ak, and shut up from me the gaping mouths, and rescued my life from destruction.
My nephesh shall esteem him and exalt him, because of all his kindnesses which he has done and will do to me.

153.intro: Spoken by Dawiḏ when returning thanks to Aluahim, who had delivered him from the lion and the wolf, and he had slain both of them.

verses.t: With a loud voice, esteem Aluahim; in the qahal of many proclaim his esteem.
Amid the multitude of the upright esteem his praise, and speak of his esteem with the righteous.
To good things join your nephesh, and to perfect things, to esteem the Most High.
Join together to make known his yasha, and do not be indolent to make known his strength and his beauty to all the simple.
For to make known the esteem of Yahuah wisdom is given, and to recount the multitude of his works she is made known to man;
To make known to the simple his strength, to make those without heart consider his greatness;
Those far from her gates, those driven from her entrances.
For the Most High is the Master of Ya'aqoḇ, and his esteem is upon all his works.
And a man who esteems the Most High is wanted as one presenting an offering, as one who brings he-goats and sons of cattle,
as one who fattens the mizbe'ach with a multitude of burnt offerings, as incense–a soothing aroma from the hand of the righteous.
From the gates of the righteous her voice is heard, and from the qahal of the reverent her song of praise.
When they eat in full she is spoken of, and when they drink in community together.
Their conversation is of the Torah of the Most High, their sayings are to make known his strength.
How far from the wicked are her sayings, from all the proud, to know her.
Behold, the eyes of Yahuah are upon the good to spare them, and upon those who esteem him he will magnify his chesed; From evil times he will deliver their nepheshoth.
Baruk is Yahuah, who redeems the afflicted from the hand of the stranger;
Who raises a Horn out of Ya'aqoḇ, and a Judge of the nations out of Is rael;
That he may prolong his dwelling in Tsiyon, and may adorn our age in Yahrushalayim.

154.intro: The prayer of Ḥizqiyahu when enemies surrounded him.

verses.t: O Yahuah, I have called to you, hearken to me.
I have stretched my hands to your qadash (Set Apart) dwelling place;
Incline your ear and grant me my request, and do not withhold what I seek from me.
Build my nephesh, and do not destroy it, and do not lay it bare before the wicked.
Bring the rewards of evil away from me, O Judge of Truth.
O Yahuah, do not judge me according to my sins, for no man will be righteous before you all his life.
Make me understand, O Yahuah, your Torah, and teach me of your mishpatim.
And the multitude shall hear of your works, and peoples shall esteem of your esteem.
Remember me and do not forget me, and do not bring me to a place of desires.
Make the sins of my youth far from me, and do not remember my transgressions against me.
Cleanse me, O Yahuah, from the evil plague, and do not add it, to return it to me.
Dry its roots within me, and do not let its leaves sprout in me.
You are esteem, O Yahuah, therefore my request before you is fulfilled.
To whom shall I cry, and it will be given to me, and of the sons of Aḏam, what shall their strength add to me?
From before you, O Yahuah, comes my safety; I called on Yahuah and he answered, and he healed the brokenness of my heart.
I slumbered and slept, I dreamt and also was helped, and Yahuah sustained me.
They sorely pained my heart, I will return thanks because Yahuah delivered me.
Now I will rejoice in their shame; I have hoped in you, and I shall not be ashamed.
Give you esteem forever, even forever and ever.
Deliver Yasharal your elect, and those of the house of Ya'aqoḇ your proved one.

155.intro: When the people obtained permission from Koresh to return home.

verses.t: … and I am poor, for …
For no maggot thanks you, and no worm recounts your chesed; Only the living will thank you, all whose feet totter will thank you.
When you make known your chesed to them, and you cause them to understand your righteousness. For in your hand is the nephesh of all the living, you have given breath to all flesh.
Do towards us, O Yahuah, according to your goodness, according to the multitude of your chesed, and the multitude of your righteous deeds.
Yahuah listens to the voice of those who love his name, and does not relinquish his chesed from them.
Baruk is Yahuah, doer of righteousness, who crowns his reverent with chesed and mercies.
My nephesh roars to praise your name, to respect in joyful shout your chesed; To tell of your faithfulness, there is no limit.
I belonged to death for my sins, and my iniquity had sold me to Sheol.
Yet you delivered me, O Yahuah, according to the multitude of your chesed, and according to the multitude of your righteous deeds.
I, too, have loved your name, and in your shadow I have taken refuge.
When I remember your strength my heart shall prevail, and upon your chesed I was supported.
Forgive me, O Yahuah, for I have sinned, and cleanse me from my iniquity.
Grant me a ruach of faithfulness and knowledge, be gracious to me, so I will not be lightly esteemed by reason of iniquity.
Do not let Satan have power over me, nor an unclean ruach; Pain and an evil inclination, do not let them possess my bones.
For you, O Yahuah, are my praise, and for you I wait every day.
My brothers shall be glad with me, and the house of my father is astonished by your graciousness.
forever I will be glad in you.
I will remember you for a berakah, O Tsiyon, with all my strength I love you; Baruk is your memory forever.
Your hope is great, O Tsiyon, and shalom and your awaited yasha will come.
Generation and generation shall dwell in you, and reverent generations shall be your beauty.
They who desire the day of your sal vat i on, and shall rejoice in the abundance of your esteem;
They shall nurse on the radiance of your esteem, and in your beautiful squares they shall be as tinkling ornaments.
You shall remember the reverence of your naḇi'im, and you shall beautify yourself in the deeds of the reverent.
Cleanse violence from your midst; falsehood and iniquity, let them be cut off from you.
Your sons shall rejoice within you, and your beloved shall be joined to you.
O How they wait for your yasha, and your perfect ones have mourned for you.
Your hope shall not perish, O Tsiyon, and your expectation will not be forgotten.
Who is this–a righteous man who perishes? or who is this–one who escapes in his iniquity?
Man is tried according to his way, a person is repaid according to his deeds.
Your enemies who are around you are cut off, O Tsiyon, and all who hate you shall be scattered.
Pleasant in the nostril is your praise, O Tsiyon, rising over all the world.
Many times I will remember you for a berakah, I will bless you with all my heart.
You shall attain everlasting righteousness, and you shall receive berakoth from the esteemed.
Take a vision which speaks of you, and dreams which the naḇi'im demanded of you.
Heighten and broaden, O Tsiyon, commend the Most High your redeemer. My nephesh will be glad in your esteem.
A multitude shall gather and shall praise the name of Yahuah, for he comes to judge all works;
To put to rest the wicked from the earth, and their sons shall not be found forever.
And the shamayim shall give their dew, and there shall be no blight in their borders.
And the earth shall give fruit in her time, and her produce shall not fail.
Fruit trees shall be full on all their vines, and they shall not fail her produce.
The poor shall eat and be satisfied, those who fear Yahuah …
… and from them.
Then shall the shamayim and earth give praise together, let all the stars of twilight praise him.
Be glad, O Yahuḏah, in your gladness, be glad in your gladness and rejoice in your rejoicing.
Feast your feasts, pay your vows, for there is no Beliya‛al in your midst.
May you lift up your hand, may you strengthen your right hand.
Behold, your enemies shall perish, and all workers of iniquity shall be scattered.
But you, O Yahuah, are forever.
Your esteem shall be forever and ever. HalleluYah.
Yahuah is great and qadash (Set Apart), exceedingly qadash (Set Apart) from generation to generation.
Greatness goes before him, and after him a multitude of many waters.
Chesed and truth are about his face, truth and mishpat and righteousness are the foundation of his throne.
He divides light from darkness, he establishes dawn in the knowledge of his heart.
When all his mal'akim saw it they sang for joy, for he showed them that which they did not know;
Crowning the mountains with produce, good food for all the living.
Baruk is the Maker of the earth in his power, who establishes the world in his wisdom.
By his understanding he stretched out the shamayim, and brought forth ruach from his storehouses.
He made lightnings for the rain, and raised a mist from the end of the earth.
I was a young man, yet to have erred when I sought her.
She came to me in her beauty, and finally I enquired of her.
Even as a blossom diminishes with the ripening of grapes, so shall a heart be glad in her.
My foot has trodden in uprightness, for from my youth I have known her.
I inclined my ear a little, and I found much instruction.
And she became a nurse to me, to my teacher I will give my Greatness.
I planned that I would make sport: I was zealous for good and will not turn back.
My nephesh was kindled in her, and I could not turn back my face.
My nephesh continued after her, and in her heights I will not let myself ease.
I opened my hands, and considered her nakedness.
I cleansed my palms, towards her I directed my nephesh, and I found her in pureness.
I have had my heart joined with her from the beginning, therefore I shall not be forsaken.
My heart was troubled in seeking her, therefore I have gotten a good possession.
Yahuah has given me a tongue for my reward, and I will praise him with it.
Draw near to me, you unlearned, and dwell in the house of learning.
Wherefore are you slow, and what do you say to these things, seeing your nepheshoth are very thirsty?
I opened my mouth and said: Buy her for yourselves without money;
Put your neck under the yoke, and let your nephesh receive instruction;
She is hard at hand to find. Behold with your eyes, that I have laboured but a little, and have gotten much rest for myself.
Get learning with a great sum of money, and get much gold by her.
Let your nephesh be glad in his chesed, and do not be ashamed of his praise.
Work your work in good time, and he will give you your wages in his time.
The Ruach of Yahuah spoke by me, and his word was on my tongue.
The Aluahim of Yasharal said to me, the Rock of Yasharal spoke:
A ruler of men is to be righteous, a ruler is to fear Aluahim.
And he shall be as morning light when the sun rises, a morning without clouds, shining from the rain as grass from the earth.
For is not my house so with Aluahim? For he has made an everlasting berith with me, ordered in all things and kept.
For it is all my yasha and all my desire, therefore will he not make it grow?
And the sons of Beliya‛al as thorns shall be thrust away–all of them, for they cannot be taken in hand.
And the man who shall touch them must be armed with iron and the shaft of a spear, and in fire they shall be utterly burned in their place.

162.intro: And these are the last words of Dawiḏ, the utterance of Dawiḏ son of Yahshai, and the utterance of the man raised up on high, the anointed of the Aluahim of Ya'aqoḇ, and the pleasant psalmist of Yasharal:

verses.t: And Dawiḏ son of Yahshai was wise and a light as the light of the sun, and a scribe, and understanding and perfect in all his ways before Aluahim and man.
And Yahuah gave to him a ruach of understanding and light.

And he wrote three thousand and six hundred psalms; and songs to sing before the mizbe'ach, over the perpetual burnt offering for day after day, for all the days of the year, four and sixty and three hundred;
And for Shabbath offerings, two and fifty songs; and for offerings for the heads of the months, and for all the appointed days and Yom Kippur, thirty songs.
And all the songs which he spoke were six and forty and four hundred; and songs to play over the stricken, four.
And the total was four thousand and fifty.
All these he spoke in neḇuah which was given to him from before the Most High.
Then I saw a Philistine, taunt ing from the ranks by his idols.
But I drew his sword and cut off his head, and took away the reproach from the sons of Yasharal …

164.intro: At the beginning of the strength of Dawiḏ since he was anointed by the naḇi of Aluahim.

verses.t: Call all the time in the name of Yahuah to the shamayim; For he will come to you in the night, and say to him:
Who are you? You shall fear man and the seed of the qadashiyms (Set Apart Ones).
Your face is a face of vanity, your horns are horns of a dream.
You are darkness and not light, iniquity and not righteousness.
The Chief of Hosts, Yahuah, will make you descend to the lowest Sheol, and he will shut the bronze doors.
Through these no light shall pass, and the sun shall not shine for you; Which will shine upon the righteous, to illuminate his face.
And you will say: Is there not certainly a helper with the righteous, to go and to recompense the evil done to him, that truth from darkness, righteousness for him …
for eternity, all the sons of Beliya‛al. Selah.
And he shall call upon the name of Yahuah against the spirits and the demons …
These are the demons, and Prince Mastema … who the Deep, the Great Aluahim of … his people … healing.
those who lean upon your name, and call upon Yahuah of Hosts, the Aluahim of Yasharal.
Whose strength is in Yahuah, Aluahim of mighty ones, who made the shamayim and the earth and all which is in them.
Who separated between the light and between the darkness;
… the deeps the earth, and the earth, who does the signs and the wonders which are in the earth.
Yahuah is he who made these in his strength, satisfying all his messengers and all the qadash (Set Apart) seed who stand themselves before him;
And he calls as witness all the heavens and all the earth against them who committed sin against all men, and committed evil against all man.
And they know his wonderful secrets, which they do not obey.
And he will strike them with a blow, if they will not refrain by reason of fear from before Yahuah, to … and for killing the nepheshoth of the servants of Yahuah, and they will fear that great blow.
And one among you will … servants of Yahuah;
great and and great … satisfying …
And the great … forceful and …
All the earth cries out towards the shamayim, and on that day Yahuah will smite you with a great blow, which is for your destruction …

And in his burning anger he will send a forceful mal'ak against you to do all his words, who will not have chesed upon you, who rules over all these things, who will make you descend to the Great Deep, and to the deepest Sheol;
And … and it will be exceedingly dark in the Great Deep, and you will be no more upon the earth to afflict man forever.
And you will be bound there by the Curse of Abaddon according to the burning anger of Yahuah, and held there in darkness for all times of humiliation.
shall be your gift, …
… which … the stricken …
… volunteers of and Raphael healed them.
Jerusalem, which is the city chosen by YahUAH forever and ever.
She shall be the dwellingplace of the qadash (Set Apart), for the name of Yahuah is called upon her, and his esteem is seen upon Yahrushalayim and Tsiyon.
Who will utter the name of Yahuah, and who shall make all his praises heard?
Yahuah remembered him in his chen and visited him, to show good things to his chosen, to be glad in the gladness of his people.
And he made for you a man who instructed you, for it is he whose words they kept, which are for all the sons of Yasharal.
Your hand will not save you, for the power of Aluahim is what does good.
And the hateful wicked, how long will you delight to do evil, lest iniquity perish?
I have told of, and I will meditate on his marvel, and she shall be to me for a teacher.
Mishpat shall go forth from my mouth, and to the simple and they will understand, and to those without heart and they will know.
O Yahuah, how mighty are your marvels;
In days he made shamayim and earth, and by the word of his mouth they were established;
And channels which run swiftly as light, and that there shall be ponds, and all are swallowed in them.
And he said for there to be night and stars and cesilim, and that they shall shine to keep light upon the face of the earth.
And he made every tree, and all the fruit of the vine, and all the increase of the field, and according to his word …
And he made man and stood them up by his Ruach, to rule over all these which are on the ground, and over all which is in the sea.
From month to month, from appointed time to appointed time, from day to day, to eat the produce of the earth.
And he made beasts and birds, and all which is for them, to eat the fattest of all;
And also to have dominion and to rule over them, and all his hosts and his messengers which are before him he has ordered to serve man and to minister to them;
And …
Hear, O my Aluahim, your … is my strength …
I will recount before those who fear you … with me …
As for your thoughts, who shall understand them? For my adversaries are a myriad before you; You know them, and those who hate my nephesh you fetter before your eyes.
For I will live …
For you will not hide the sins of those who know understanding, but you will kill them.
O Aluahim of my yasha, my days are stored secretly with me, and what can a man do? Behold, here I am.
And how you deliver to those who wait for my hand a sword on the day of wrath, to those who say to turn.
They have woven a crown for my head, for splendour is the garrison of their esteem and witness.
… the petition of my lips, remove their names from the Book of Life;
And those who frighten me shall be ended, and my adversaries shall be finished.
And no more shall and you shall receive from me a song and thanksgiving; … with you …
O Yahuah Almighty, the Aluahim of our fathers, Aḇraham and Yahtsḥaq and Ya'aqoḇ, and of their righteous seed; Who has made the shamayim and the earth with all their adornment;
Who has bound the sea with the word of your mitsvah; Who has closed the Deep, and sealed it with your fearful and esteemed name;
Whom all things revere, and tremble before the face of your power; For the magnificence of your esteem is unendurable, and the wrath of your threatening against sinners is irresistible.
The chesed of your promise is both immeasurable and inscrutable; For you are Yahuah the Most High, compassionate, longsuffering, and most merciful, repenting of the evils of men.
You, O Yahuah, according to the abundance of your goodness, have proclaimed repentance and forgiveness to those who have sinned against you;
And in the multitude of your kindnesses you have decreed for sinners repentance to yasha.
Surely you, O Yahuah, the Aluahim of the just, have not appointed repentance for the just, for Aḇraham and Yahtsḥaq and Ya'aqoḇ, who have not sinned against you;
But you have appointed repentance for me, a sinner, for I have sinned above the number of the sand of the sea.
My transgressions are multiplied, O Yahuah, they are multiplied, and I am not worthy to look at or see the height of shamayim for the multitude of my iniquities,
Being bowed down by many iron bonds, so that I cannot lift up my head, and there is no release for me;
For I have provoked your anger, and have done evil before you, not doing your will, nor keeping your mitsvot, but setting up abominations, and multiplying offenses.
And now I bend the knee of my heart, beseeching your goodness. I have sinned, O Yahuah, I have sinned, and I acknowledge my transgressions.
But I pray and beseech you, release me, O Yahuah, release me, and do not destroy me with my transgressions.
Do not keep evils for me in anger forever, nor condemn me to the lowest parts of the earth.
For you are Aluahim, the Aluahim of the repenting, and in me you will show all your benevolence; For you will save me, who is unworthy, according to your great chesed.
And I will praise you continually all the days of my life, for all the hosts of the shamayim sings to you, and yours is the esteem for ever and ever. Amen.

170.intro: Prayer of Menashsheh, king of Yahuḏah, when the king of Ashshur imprisoned him.

verses.t: And I understand, and those who do not understand, I make prudent.
And to him who.
And I dread you, and I cleanse myself from the abominations which I have acknowledged, and I give my nephesh to be humbled before you.
They multiplied transgressions, and against me they plot, to shut me up.
And I trusted in you, …
And do not set me in mishpat with you, O my Aluahim, …
And save me from those who take council together against me, who loose a tongue of deceit.
… for me vain works …
… upon me …
… your great chesed, …
And you gave to me a horn … in you,
And fools despise your statute, and your splendour and your beauty they abhor.
And like clouds they shall be spread upon the face of the earth.
They shall be dispersed in great number until …
Man will not be strong, and will not rise against you.
You have tried all, and the elect, like an offering, you cleanse before you– but the hated, like impurity, you reject.
And a stormy ruach you cause to destroy all their doings, but those who fear you are before you continually;
Their horns are horns of iron to gore many, and they gore the wicked.
And on their hoofs you shall place bronze, and transgressors like dung shall be trampled upon the face of the dirt.
And and they are driven from before … in them.
And your Ruach … and a burning fire shall devour them …
… for you shall … in his sight.
For the people of the land had done abominably, all the land came to exceedingly impure uncleanness, and marvelously evil from the beginning.
And he took council within his heart to destroy them from upon her, and to make upon her a people.
He set in you, and gave them to you by his Ruach: naḇi'im to make you consider and to teach you.
Your Aluahim descended from shamayim and spoke with you to make you consider, and to turn you back from the works of the inhabitants.
He gave statutes, laws, and mitsvot, ina berith established by the hand of Mosheh his servant.
He told you to take possession, to dwell upon the land, if you would cleanse and …
… to consider within yourselves, if you will be his, and if not he vowed to take you from the land,
and to break the berith he cut with you, and for you to be foreigners and not rulers.
… upon wickedness, and to change the words of his mouth from …
… the Qodash haQodashim (Most Set Apart Place), the lot of the King of Kings …
You shall hear my words, and you shall consider the wisdom which goes forth from my mouth, and you shall understand that Aluahim is righteous and a true judge and a faithful witness.
If there is power in you to answer him, then speak a word to be heard.
Who among you will answer, and stand in argument with him?
For your judges are many, and there is no number to your witnesses; For if they testify against you, Yahuah will sit in mishpat with you to judge truthfully, and there is no injustice in him.
He will send his ruchot, to render in you true mishpatim: Is there understanding which you may learn beyond this?
Yahuah is Master of Masters, mighty and marvelous, and there is none like him.
He chose you from many peoples, and from great nations, to be his people, to rule over all the earth,
And he made a berith by heaven and earth, and for you to be the highest above all the nations of the earth, and to …
